scope: Local/shared-filesystem bounty-index publication. Not a provider request-budget or payout claim.

checks: canonical case variants and complete original metadata preserved
superseded CLI exit 3 preserves exact newer bytes
UTC-aware ordering allows a later read with a different offset
legacy export timestamp does not masquerade as source freshness
replace failure retains last-good bytes and removes temporary file
invalid source interval cannot replace the saved index
canonical issue identity validation remains intact
collection completes before publication lock acquisition

network: Collector responses were controlled in each child process. No HTTP request was issued. Each child invoked the collector exactly once.
windows: Windows msvcrt branch not executed in this Linux harness. Empty-file byte locking follows the documented past-EOF contract; no unlocked initialization write.
ordering: Later started_at wins; updated_at breaks ties. Times must be timezone-aware. Cooperative writers must use the same output path and filesystem with working advisory locks.
